name: Imperial Guard
bio: Stood guard for a dynasty. Standing guard for you now.
notes: Drive intake of 2026-11-05 ("A fit ancient Chinese male soldier from", rigged and animated on Meshy (Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; finger chains, where it has them, folded into the hands and refitted by hands.mjs; its clips not used)).
